name: docs-qa
title: Docs Q&A
summary: Answers questions from a folder of documents, citing the file and line.
blurb: Retrieval with nothing to install and no index to build: one tool greps the mounted documents, another reads the paragraph around a match, and the agent cites `file.md:line` for every fact. It is told the documents are the only authority, so "the documents do not cover this" is a correct answer — which is the whole point of pointing an agent at a corpus rather than asking it what it remembers.

input.question: How long do I have before an unacknowledged page escalates, and who does it go to?
